items.heading: Explains the expansion of the light of Ein Sof BH to make vessels in four phases of coarseness through the images of the organs of man, which are: eyes, ear, nose, mouth, and the more refined it is, the more important it is. The eyes are phase one, the ear phase two, the nose phase three, the mouth phase four. It contains eight matters: — 1. In Ein Sof there is no aspect of image or attainment whatsoever. In order to create the world, He extended many expansions to be roots and sources for the world of Atzilut. 2. There are four elements to everything, which are the four letters Yod Hei Vav Hei, that is, RShRD [sight, hearing, smell, speech]: Haya, Neshama, Ruach, and Nefesh; and their secret is: eyes, ear, nose, and mouth. 3. There is breath and spirit in AHP, each one more abundant than the other: in the ear the breath is scant, in the nose it is stronger, and in the mouth it is more abundant than all. 4. The ears are Bina, which is phase two, whose coarseness is scant, and it is Neshama. The nose is the secret of ZA, which is the coarseness of phase three, the coarser one, and it is Ruach. The mouth is Malchut, and it is the coarseness of phase four, the coarsest of all, and it is the light of Nefesh. 5. Sight is the secret of the light of Haya. In the eyes there is no actual breath as in AHP, which is the secret of the coarseness of phase one, the very fine one. 6. The breath in the eyes is a vessel for the surrounding light of Haya; only the direct light in it is drawn downward in the secret of the look, which is the secret of the coupling by striking. 7. The expansion of the light to make vessels, which is the secret of the look, comes from the eyes, which is the secret of the light of Hochma, and not from AHP. 8. The three breaths of AHP became the phase of vessels for Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama. — In Ein Sof there is no aspect of image or attainment whatsoever. In order to create the world, He extended many expansions to be roots and sources for the world of Atzilut
items.html: *It is known that Ein Sof has no aspect of image at all, God forbid. And when it arose in His thought to create the world by the order of Atzilut, 1He began to extend from Himself the expansion of many lights, so that they would be the phase of roots and sources for the Atzilut that would be emanated afterward.

items.heading: There are four elements to everything, which are the four letters Yod Hei Vav Hei, that is, RShRD [sight, hearing, smell, speech]: Haya, Neshama, Ruach, and Nefesh, and their secret is: eyes, ear, nose, and mouth
items.html: Let us speak by way of allegory and illustration of this matter. You already know that there are four elements to all things, and they are: sight, hearing, smell, and speech. And they are the matter of the four letters of HaVaYaH. And they are: the phase of Neshama to Neshama, and Neshama, and Ruach, and Nefesh. Let us begin to explain from the degree of Neshama, and afterward we will return to what precedes it.

items.heading: There is breath and spirit in AHP, each one more abundant than the other: in the ear the breath is scant, in the nose it is stronger, and in the mouth it is more abundant than all
items.html: 2Indeed, the organs of the ears certainly contain within them a fine spirit, and the proof of this is that when a person seals his ear well with his finger, he feels as though there is a great roaring sound within it; this is because of the spirit confined within it, which seeks to go out and cannot. After it in degree is the organ of the nose, for from it goes out a spirit more perceptible than that which goes out from the ear. And after it in degree is the organ of the mouth, for from it goes out breath and spirit stronger than all.

items.heading: The ears are Bina, which is phase two, whose coarseness is scant, and it is Neshama. The nose is the secret of ZA, which is the coarseness of phase three, the coarser one, and it is Ruach. The mouth is Malchut, and it is the coarseness of phase four, the coarsest of all, and it is the light of Nefesh
items.html: For according to the standing of the organ, so is its fineness: the ears are the phase of Bina, which is finer, and therefore the spirit that goes out from them is very fine. Likewise the organ of the nose is finer than the organ of the mouth, as mentioned. Now, by way of illustration we can say that the spirit that goes out 3from the ear is called Neshama; and from the nose it is called Ruach; and from the mouth it is called Nefesh, and so on.

items.heading: Sight is the secret of the light of Haya. In the eyes there is no actual breath as in AHP, which is the secret of the coarseness of phase one, the very fine one
items.html: *It has been explained that from the phase of sight itself, Neshama to Neshama comes about. But know that the phase of sight is not the phase of actual breath drawn from the eye, in the way of the ear, the nose, and the mouth, whose Neshama, Ruach, and Nefesh are 4actual breaths, which expand from them downward.

items.heading: The breath in the eyes is a vessel for the surrounding light of Haya; only the direct light in it is drawn downward in the secret of the look, which is the secret of the coupling by striking
items.html: But 5the eyes are not so, for their own breath remains in its place, in the phase of 6the surrounding light called Neshama to Neshama; yet there is one existence drawn from it, and it is the secret of sight and the look alone, and it is not actual breath drawn downward. Therefore, from this phase of sight the vessels called the body were made, but the phase of the breath itself of the eye is very internal, and it cannot be drawn and expanded downward.

items.heading: The expansion of the light to make vessels, which is the secret of the look, comes from the eyes, which is the secret of the light of Hochma, and not from AHP
items.html: 7And since this sight is drawn from the eyes, which are higher than the ear, the nose, and the mouth, therefore by this sight alone there was power to create and make the vessels, and their own breath was not needed either. This is not so with the ear, the nose, and the mouth, which are lower, for their own actual breath needed to expand in order to make and emanate the mentioned phases, and no existence was made from them except by the power of the breath itself. 8

items.heading: The three breaths of AHP became the phase of vessels for Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama
items.html: However, since 9the phase of the eye was not actual breath, but sight alone, therefore 10only the phase of vessels was made from it, and no more. This is not so with the ear, the nose, and the mouth, which could not even make the phase of vessels without their own actual breath; but 20since it was actual breath, they became Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama.
